import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 32;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int n;
    static Matrix identity = new Matrix();
    static Matrix[] A = new Matrix[MAXN];
    static Matrix[] prefix = new Matrix[MAXN];
    static Matrix[] suffix = new Matrix[MAXN];
    static Matrix answer = new Matrix();

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] mat = new int[MAXN][MAXN];

        void zero() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                    mat[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void printMatrix() {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                    System.out.print(mat[i][j] + (j == n ? "\n" : " "));
                }
            }
            System.out.println();
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix rhs) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix();
            res.zero();
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                        sum += (long) this.mat[i][k] * rhs.mat[k][j];
                    }
                    res.mat[i][j] = (int) (sum % MOD);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        n = sc.nextInt();

        identity.zero();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            identity.mat[i][i] = 1;
        }
        answer = identity;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            A[i] = new Matrix();
            A[i].zero();
            A[i].mat[i][i] = 1;
        }

        prefix[0] = new Matrix();
        prefix[0].zero();
        prefix[0] = identity;

        suffix[n + 1] = new Matrix();
        suffix[n + 1].zero();
        suffix[n + 1] = identity;

        while (m != 0) {
            long u = m % n;
            if (u != 0) {
                long s = 0, v = m / n;
                while (v != 0) {
                    s = (s + v % n) % n;
                    v /= n;
                }
                u = (s + u - 1) % n + 1;
                for (; u != s; u--) {
                    if (u <= 0) u += n;
                    answer = A[(int) u].multiply(answer);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                prefix[i] = prefix[i - 1].multiply(A[i]);
            }
            for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) {
                suffix[i] = A[i].multiply(suffix[i + 1]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                A[i] = suffix[i].multiply(prefix[i - 1]);
            }
            m /= n;
        }

        int res = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            res += answer.mat[n + 1][i];
        }
        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }
}
